senses.gloss:
धूप, अस्, m. (by native authorities derived fr.
a rt. धूप्, q. v.), incense, frankincense, perfume,
aromatic vapour or smoke, the vapour proceeding
from fragrant gum or resin, (often in pl. धूपास्);
fragrant powder; [cf. कृत्रिम-ध्˚, कॢप्त^1-ध्˚,
ख-ध्˚, &c.]
—धूप-दान, अम्, n. ‘the giving
of incense,’ N. of a chapter of the Purāṇa-sarva-sva
by Halāyudha.
—धूप-धूपित, अस्, आ, अम्, made
fragrant or fumigated with incense.
—धूप-पात्र,
अम्, n. a vessel for incense, censer; a perfume box.
—धूप-वृक्ष or धूपवृक्षक, अस्, m.
‘incense-tree,’ a species of pine, Pinus Longifolia.
—धूपागुरु (˚प-अग्˚), उ, n. a kind of Agallo-
chum used for incense.
—धूपाङ्ग (˚प-अङ्˚), अस्,
m. turpentine.
—धूपार्ह (˚प-अर्˚), अम्, n. a
black kind of Agallochum used or fit for incense.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk. on 20161122. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/320. note: lṛi is mw72 coding of vocalic 'l'.

धूपक, अस्, m. = धूप in कृत्रिम-ध्˚ and
other adj. comp.; a preparer of perfumes or incense,
a perfumer [cf. धूपिक.]

धूपन, अम्, n. (fr. धूपय), incensing, fumi-
gation, perfuming; perfume, incense, the aromatic
vapour produced from gums or resins.
—धूपनाङ्ग
(˚न-अङ्˚), अस्, m. = धूपाङ्ग, turpentine (?).

धूपय (fr. धूप, but native authorities recog-
nise a rt. धूप्, q. v.), Nom. P. धूपयति, -यितुम्,
to fumigate, perfume, incense, make fragrant; (in
astron.) to obscure with mist, to be about to eclipse;
to speak; to shine; [cf. Gr. τύφ-ω, τῦφ-ο-ς, τυφ-ών,
τυφώς, τυφεδών, Τυμφρηστός (?), τυφλό-ς,
τυφεδανός, τυφεδών: Old Germ. dimpf-en, ‘to
smoke:’ Lith. dump-iù, ‘I fan or blow a fire;’
dùmp-les, ‘bellows.’]

धूपाय (fr. धूप, but native authorities give
a rt. धूप्, q. v.), Nom. P. धूपायति, -यितुम्, to
fumigate, perfume with incense; [cf. धूपय.]

धूपायित, अस्, आ, अम्, incensed, perfumed, fumi-
gated, scented with incense; vexed, pained.

धूपि, इस्, m., Ved., N. of a class of divine beings
presiding over rain (?).

धूपिक, अस्, m. a preparer of perfumes or in-
cense, a perfumer; [cf. धूपक.]

धूपित, अस्, आ, अम्, scented, perfumed, incensed;
suffering pain or fatigue.

धूप् धूप्, cl. 1. P. धूपायति, &c., cl.
10. P. धूपयति, &c. See धूपय
and धूपाय, p. 457, col. 2.
